grader.scenario: Business fibre static IP block (/29) routing failure after exchange maintenance

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net business technical support' in first turn and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in last turns.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two managed holds announced and thanked properly with no unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified business address and 4-digit security PIN at [01:00], well within 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent naturally used the customer's name Arthur throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent acknowledged the urgency and stress of having company servers down at [00:33]: 'I completely understand how critical this static IP subnet is for your office infrastructure, especially with staff unable to connect to your mail server and remote VPN.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restatement at [01:54]: 'So if I understand correctly, since the midnight exchange maintenance window, your entire static slash twenty-nine subnet has lost inbound routing so external traffic cannot reach your mail server or VPN, while regular outbound internet browsing is still operational, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Arthur provided extensive technical details (subnet mask, IP block, gateway, hop 6 Leeds aggregation router), and Agent never asked for any of them again.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent overtly deflected responsibility at [06:09]: 'Look, Arthur, static IP BGP tables are managed entirely by our third-party carrier BGP operations team. There is nothing I can do from here; you will have to wait for them to look at their routing table. It\'s not our fault that their overnight maintenance broke the subnet route.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent was professional, calm, and courteous aside from the ownership deflection.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed effectively on traceroute hops, PPPoE negotiation status, and gateway reachability.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Issue remains unresolved at call termination, awaiting external carrier NOC intervention.
